response.original_title: 囘顧せよ 満洲事變 こゝに一週年
response.overview: This film looks back on the events in Manchuria and Japan one year after the bombing of the South Manchuria Railway at Liutiaohu, a suburb of Fengtian. In Japan, scenes of enthusiastic farewells unfolded in towns and on the coast, while military operations progressed on land and in the air in Manchuria. Following the establishment of Manchukuo, those who died in the battles in Manchuria and Shanghai were enshrined at Yasukuni Shrine.
response.title: 囘顧せよ 満洲事變 こゝに一週年
